mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recessionary quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthening housing demand, positively affects consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, investors anticipate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6mo MA, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp and PAYEMS decreases by > 100k over 2 months, signaling labor market stress, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively affected over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, enhances consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of holiday season days with positive RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
